content:
alex: main turned red right after the merge — smoke-gpu-kvalloc failed in allocate_kv_cache. link: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/12345 :eyes:
ci-bot: pipeline #12345 failed on branch main · step: allocate_kv_cache
```
[2026-03-17 18:12:03] ERROR: Failed to allocate 268435456 bytes for kv_cache: OutOfMemoryError
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/kv_alloc.py", line 214, in allocate_kv_cache
    buf = allocator.malloc(size)
MemoryError: unable to allocate memory
```
jamie: I merged a docs-only PR (~6m ago), wasn't touching runtime. pinging @rachel and @sasha in case this touches infra.
rachel: I rolled out the kv-alloc-safety patch (PR #7650) earlier today — that change added extra retry logic around allocations but didn't change sizes. Could still interact though.
sasha: grabbing logs from the failing shards now. If it's happening on multiple shards it smells like an allocator/regression rather than a single-node fluke.
alex: it hit 3 shards in the smoke matrix, same step. quick bisect or rerun? who is on-call for infra?
rachel: I'm available to help. If we need a rollback I can prepare a revert PR for #7650.
sasha: propose quick plan: 1) rerun the exact smoke job on the same commit, 2) if it fails again, bisect recent infra merges (kv allocator related), 3) if reproduces, revert PR #7650 and run smoke again.
jamie: rerun queued: `cictl rerun --pipeline 12345 --stage allocate_kv_cache`
ci-bot: rerun started for pipeline #12345 -> run #12346 (queued)
sasha: also spinning up an isolated debug instance to try reproducing locally with the same matrix config. will update in ~10m :thumbsup:
alex: tagging @oncall-infra in case we need deeper escalation. if rerun passes we'll close; if not, bisect. :pray:
ci-bot: pipeline #12346 finished: FAILED (same error)
sasha: confirmed on the debug node — reproducible OOM at allocator malloc. starting a bisect between commits 0a1b2c..9f8e7d to narrow to the offending infra change.
rachel: opening revert PR for #7650 now — https://git.redwood/reverts/7720 (draft)
alex: nice. once revert is up let's run the smoke matrix against the revert branch. whoever lands it please ping here and I'll watch the dashboard. thanks all :eyes:
